text: [Image #1] ? how is it loading a texture while showing none.
resolution: Fixed the contradictory resumed-session state where the native host retained and rendered a valid model atlas but the React UV bridge remained null unless Paint had been active. Resident, non-stale atlases now always publish their UV preview on remount; an active Paint tool still resumes Paint, and missing/stale atlases remain gated. Added regression coverage and verified the editor typecheck and ReleaseFast build.
